create_ReplaceDataset: create a ReplaceDataset that replaces specified tokens in a fairseq dataset using a replace map
build_ReplaceDataset_with_offsets: build a ReplaceDataset with offsets to skip replacing tokens at the beginning or end of sequences
test_ReplaceDataset_getitem: test the ReplaceDataset getitem method to verify tokens are correctly replaced by replacement tokens
review_ReplaceDataset_init: review the ReplaceDataset constructor to understand how replace_map and offsets configure token replacement behavior
refactor_ReplaceDataset_masked_fill: refactor the ReplaceDataset getitem method to support batched token replacement across multiple sequence fields
